name: Hannah
quote: The source of countless wonders is a boundless intellect.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. Will we be working together again today? Don't worry, you can leave it to me.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: "Afternoon tea"? The Rossum Sector doesn't have a concept like that, and if we're too free... Well, I'll try it since you're recommending it. Mm, this is sweet!

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: As the administrator of the Rossum Sector, how could I knock off work early for such a reason? You say I won't grow taller if I burn the midnight oil? W-well, agents are born with their body types; it has nothing to do with this!

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: ...Quitting time? Not yet, I'm not sleepy... Zzz...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: I'm a Sector Administrator now, so I need to pull myself together no matter how hard things get! Urgh, coffee? That black, bitter drink? That's a little...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Although I can't quite put my finger on it, the Dolls of the Oasis feel very different from Resident Agents. Perhaps this could be useful in our research. I should tell Turing about this...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Are you asleep, Professor? I guess I'll finish up the rest by myself...

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Did Turing cause you any problems? I'm sorry. I need to take responsibility too...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: It feels like this process still has some room for improvement... If you have the time, why don't we design a new plan for it together?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: ...Could you do that again, please?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: These are neural dampers, not ordinary ears!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Um... It feels kind of weird...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I'm just manning a shift? Don't you have more important work for me...

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I am the administrator of the Rossum Sector, Hannah, here to visit. For the sake of our shared prosperity with the Oasis, I'll be imposing on you for a while, Professor.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I've gained more useful knowledge!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: If only I could have gotten this strength sooner...

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Thank you for everything you've done for me, Professor. Now, it's time for me to repay you.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Please leave it to me.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: This is our chance to strike back.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: This time, I'll definitely...!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: You had this coming.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: All according to my calculations.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: This is impossible...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
An oath!? ...Is it really okay to pick me? Even though I'm not a Doll and I can't go back to the real world?
So we can come up with a way ourselves? That really does sound like an answer you'd give... Yes, with my processing power and your guidance we can do anything, Professor.
In that case, I can only say yes to you. But you have to promise me something too, okay? From now on, regardless of what kind of problems that come up, we're going to face them together. It's a deal.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: We Resident Agents don't really think too much about the concept of time. To us, every day is much the same as the one before. However, in the Oasis, I can sense how different each day is. Thank you for teaching me to look forward to the "new year", Professor.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: So this the legendary festival where people give chocolate to each other... If, if I give you a piece, will you give me a gift in return? Don't get me wrong, this is just to promote this highly-efficient way of replenishing operands to everyone in the Rossum Sector, and not because it's a personal interest of mine... So what's your answer?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: "Since you're certain you can meet every year, why do you feel such sorrow?" — Most ordinary agents would react this way after hearing that story. However, I think I can understand it. Probabilities alone won't comfort you if there's something you truly don't wish to lose... I wouldn't have understood that concept without you, Professor.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Although understanding human thought patterns helps Turing and I in our work, wasting all those operands on a costume parade is hard to understand... Hm? There's a snack party afterwards? In that case... Trick or treat!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: To agents, humans are our gods, and humans have gods of their own... If there was a god of agents on the cloud server, then the Christmas we ought to celebrate is... Oh no, my neural cloud systems are showing signs of overheating, I need a candy cane to cool down...

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Today was the day you were "created" right, Professor? If not for Turing's 1642nd act of perseverance, I would not exist. And as for you, Professor, it was due to a one-in-a-hundred-million coincidence that led to you being born, right? And the odds of us meeting each other are billions to one; an astonishingly small amount. From that point of view, I think I can understand why humans celebrate this day. In that case, happy birthday, Professor.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Now that you mention it, there are some specialized questions related to AI research that I haven't asked you yet, Professor. Aren't you an expert in the field? Here's a 572-page thesis; if you could just help me look it over...
Hm? You don't have time? Alright then, I'm not a kid either and I can do this research by myself. Um, why are you sweating so heavily?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
I've learned a lot from the Oasis, as well as a brand new perspective I could never have gotten from Turing or my work diaries in the Rossum Sector. As I thought, you can't advance the development of practical and cost-efficient AI by hiding in your room; you need real-world experience too.
"The real world"... Sounds pretty distant to me. If the Oasis hadn't lost contact with the real world, could we have avoided the tragedies of the past?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: If I get the chance, I'd love to invite you to the Rossum Sector as a guest. Although we're still facing the Entropic threat, we can rebuild from them as many times as needed, so long as Turing and I are there and those agents combine their efforts. Someday, I want to fulfil my duties as an administrator... and make Rossum as wonderful as the Oasis.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Frankly speaking, I often feel quite uneasy. After Turing... After that incident, I've forced myself to get it together and devoted myself to the work of running the Sector. I kept telling myself that I need to safeguard everything that Turing sacrificed herself to protect. But what can I do? All the other agents are actually senior to me, and there are many things and procedures which I don't understand. Everyone's counting on me, but who can I count on?
So you're saying I can count on everyone too? That's... quite an unexpected answer. Indeed, it should have occurred to me after seeing the way the Exiles live. Well done, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
I often wonder if I'm living up to Turing's sacrifice. I'm nothing more than an agent she created, an entity that Magrasea did not allow to exist. I took over Turing's mission and ran the Rossum Sector, desperately trying to rebuild everything, all because I want to prove that I'm not wasting her contributions.
But now, I'm starting to understand... She didn't want me to be bound by the past. I want to overcome the past and move forward with Turing as she is now.
Although I can't clearly map our future course, I believe that I have the courage to face it... Are you willing to join us, Professor?

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Uh-huh.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Ah…

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehe.

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Hm?

career:
Hannah, agent designation T1642, is the current administrator of the Rossum Sector and the newest generation of the Rossum Sector's home-grown agents. There is no official information on file with the Magrasea authorities regarding this model of agent and thus Hannah's individual characteristics, the special features of her neural cloud, and her field of specialty are a complete blank. The only thing that is certain is that she is capable of carrying out the duties of an administrator for a large sector.

After assuming the role of administrator, not only was order restored to the Rossum Sector in an extremely short period of time, but various production and research projects quickly got back on track. During this time, the sector maintained smooth operand flow. Once it established a working relationship with the Oasis, the scale of this operand movement increased further, and it is now regarded by the Traders as one of the most prosperous sectors in Magrasea.
infoStories:
Most sectors in Magrasea are presided over by an agent administrator who in turn takes orders from humans. Even in the extremely rare situation where a sector loses its administrator, the Sanctifiers will usually help to select a new administrator to take up the mantle. This is standard practice for Magrasea's agents, but Hannah has overturned those practices. Certain agents with particularly keen logic have noticed the significance of this exception from the regulations of Magrasea, but they are in the minority. Most agents might react to this transfer of permissions or the youthful appearance of the new administrator with curiosity, but they do not think about the far-reaching implications of this situation for the most part.

Leaving these questions aside, Hannah's performance is beyond reproach if going by results alone. This not only highlights her efficiency in information processing but also her tremendous creativity. Whenever she encounters a challenging obstacle in a research project or sector affairs, Hannah's response differs from the average agent; she does not choose to attack the problem head-on, but to find a way around it and achieve her objective through other means. Few agents in Magrasea have mastered this technique, but she has used it to overcome various issues and lead the Rossum Sector onward. Perhaps only the word "gifted" suffices to describe Hannah's astounding performance.

Ever since Hannah took over the Rossum Sector, one could say that life there was completely flipped upside down. On the one hand, she built laboratories and founded new project groups to elevate Rossum's research environment to the next level. On the other hand, she earmarked operands for developing the sector's non-research facilities and began installing the formerly-banned emotional modules in newly-created agents. Though it was believed that the latter course of action would deplete the sector's operand reserves, Rossum's operand flow instead grew by the day and its R&D efficiency improved further, thanks to the cooperation of the Traders and the Oasis.

However, Hannah did not throw the excess operands into trade. Instead, she invested them all into the construction of sector defenses. The reason for that was because their battle with the Sanctifiers had left a very deep impression on Hannah and made her realize the importance of safety and security. As the situation in Magrasea grew steadily more chaotic, she realized that the Rossum Sector would have to look to its own defense since the Oasis could only provide assistance.

Of course, not every agent supported Hannah's actions. Quite a few of them voiced their opposition to her after being outfitted with emotional modules. However, Hannah quashed these objections by pointing to the sector's operand flow. The young administrator remained set on her course, without the slightest bit of doubt.

In the minds of most agents, Hannah is a tall, formidable, and mature woman who storms in and out of places like a gust of wind—after all, her hardline methods and their impressive results are well-known even beyond the sector.

Thus, most agents' neural clouds tend to freeze a bit when they actually see Hannah. After all, seeing Hannah discuss serious topics like the development of the sector with her youthful face and her sweet voice tends to take them by surprise.

That said, there are times when Hannah does act a little more like her apparent age. When an agent innocently questioned an engineering decision she once proposed, Hannah did not flare up in anger or insist that she was correct. Instead, she locked herself up in her office to study the topic for three full days before emerging with a thoroughly-researched paper on the subject at hand. When she presented it during the meeting, Hannah held her chest high and her eyes were smug, which all left a deep impression on all the people present.

Perhaps they've forgotten, but Hannah was never an old hand, or an experienced agent; she simply had to give the impression of maturity because she had too much responsibility on her shoulders.

Hannah is the administrator of the Rossum Sector, but she isn't just its administrator. From problems as large as the direction in which the sector should develop, to issues as minor as an argument between two agents, Hannah handles all problems that come her way regardless of the scope or magnitude. Hannah easily qualifies as one of the hardest working leaders of the various major sectors. Her abilities have long since been acknowledged by countless agents, but rather than her abilities, these agents are more interested in knowing what exactly keeps Hannah going? After all, the next generation of agents were born after Hannah came into existence while the older generations had only just been fitted with emotional modules, so they could not comprehend the deeper meaning behind their fragmented memories. All they know is that what little free time Hannah has is spent in the sector's "Data Center".

There were agents who once asked the Traders, who are said to know everything, about the secret behind this. However, the price the Traders asked for that information dispelled their curiosity. This response was also a summary of their attitude towards the matter—if Hannah didn't want to talk about it, then they would let her keep her secrets. The price of friendship is very high indeed!

After the Entropic viral invasion, Hannah's interactions with the Oasis became more and more frequent. Through the joint efforts of both parties, the ruined sector's facilities were soon rebuilt. The Data Center was one of the most heavily-damaged regions, and at Hannah's command, it was also restored, unsealed, and opened to the public.

Whenever she visits the Oasis, Hannah doesn't put on any airs, probably because she can finally unburden herself of her role as an administrator and enjoy some free time. She accepts Willow's special interviews, tours the Oasis with Angela, listens to Bonee's interesting tales from the Medical Department, samples Choco's specially made desserts... if the young agents of the Rossum Sector were here, they would surely be surprised to see that the genuine smile on her face was exactly the same as the one on theirs.
oathDesc: The slight twitching of her ears reveals her hidden feelings.

projections.name: Persevering Glow
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"No more hesitation and no more standing still. I'll keep to the pace that leads toward tomorrow."

"No more hesitation and no more standing still. I'll keep to the pace that leads toward tomorrow."

projections.name: Luxuriant Spirit
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"The sapling nourished on wisdom and emotions will ultimately sprout a magnificent canopy of leaves."

skinList.name: Overflowing Scent
skinList.desc:
First Bloom — A school uniform suitable for early spring, custom-made for freshmen and stirring the heart to early flutters.
The presents spilling out of her locker are vexing, but the shy smile on this little honor student's must be because she spotted a name she was looking forward to among the pile."Honestly, preparing the return gift is harder than studying for my exams..."

skinList.name: Hiemal Prayer
skinList.desc:
The silver bells of Christmas tinkle quietly as diaphanous swimsuits blend with the color of the water. This is the most mysterious and tempting tale circulating in this kingdom of ice and snow.
Wishes cascade like snow in a clear sky, their beauty reflected in this tiny crystal globe.
"Fairy godmothers have their worries too. For instance, which wish should I grant? Since today is a special day, I'll indulge myself and answer all your prayers."
